title: Ankhorage API Fastify Adapter
summary: Adapts the Ankhorage API runtime to Fastify routes, requests, replies, and host integration.
purpose: Host portable Ankhorage APIs with Fastify while preserving the framework-neutral runtime and contracts.
responsibilities: Translate Fastify requests and replies at the transport boundary.
Register projected API routes with a Fastify host.
Own Fastify-specific host creation and configuration.
boundaries: Does not own API operation dispatch or handler semantics.
Does not own portable API contracts.
Does not add Fastify-specific behavior to @ankhorage/api.
audience: Applications hosting Ankhorage APIs through Fastify.
useCases: Register a portable API definition on a Fastify server.
Create a configured Fastify host for the Ankhorage API runtime.
Inspect the projected Fastify routes for an API definition.

invariants: Fastify translation and host configuration stay at the adapter edge.
